How bot checks work

Teams that publish research increasingly put a Cloudflare interstitial in front of their pages. A reader may see a just a moment screen or a checking your browser message, and the g-recaptcha widget or cf-turnstile element can also appear on sign-in forms. This article explains how those checks work, why they exist, and what they cost site owners and readers.
